sampling_notes.cause: The perturbation draws (default_rng(20261027)) perturb every strip derivative entry in the cache. strips_info.json was committed (3e828dd) before the strip TM index solves were added (6b84f2d), so the rerun draws more entries and the random sequence differs. Deterministic values reproduce exactly; the sampled statistics agree within sampling error (see max_abs_rel_diff).
